## Description

Move the demo request from /trust#demo to its own page /demo: "See Medvya with your own clinic's day", the three steps, the contact fields and a preferred day and time. The request is stored in the Leads module with the existing privacy notice and consent (MDV-P1-003). The confirmation says the time is requested and the team will confirm by email, and offers "create your practice now" (sign-up). /trust#demo redirects to /demo. No calendar provider is added.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given JavaScript is off, when a visitor picks a time and sends the form, then the request is stored with the time in UTC and the confirmation page shows it in the visitor's region time zone.
- [ ] **AC2.** Given the consent box is not ticked, when the form is sent, then the server refuses it (consent_required) and nothing is stored.
- [ ] **AC3.** Given a past or malformed time, when the form is sent, then the server refuses it with an error under the field.
- [ ] **AC4.** Public form endpoints are rate-limited and anti-forgery protected; no contact value appears in logs or the URL.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
